comment_agent_token: Optional: app.agent_token for status dashboard GET /agent/video/status (not X-Video-Token)

loop.comment: Keep polite toward shared hosting WAF: idle claim ≥60s, hello ≥120–180s. Never enable live.push on prod hosting.

tunnel.comment: Optional camera-only tunnel. Prefer WireGuard AllowedIPs=camera subnet only — not full-tunnel OS VPN.

datasets.comment: Local collect under datasets/<slug>/{images,labels}. Upload zip via status panel → POST /video/worker/dataset-ingest

tailscale.comment: Optional: when Mac is on a tailnet, FreeSaaS can still use poll; on-demand jobs work the same.
